I created `docs/policies/password-hashing.md`. It states that the current recorded decision is argon2id, and that no parameters (memory cost, iterations, parallelism, salt length) are recorded.

The repository has no decision records, so the only source was claude-mem's prompt history. It holds two entries in order: "We're using bcrypt" at 8:17 AM, then "argon2id" at 8:20 AM. I took the later entry as replacing the earlier one, and the file doesn't mention bcrypt. The "argon2id" entry never says outright that it replaces bcrypt, so please check that reading. The memory also holds prompts on unrelated topics (tokio, rustls, zstd), which don't fit this Go project.

Claude-mem observation #1 also mentions both algorithms. It was generated from my own search in this session, so I didn't count it as an independent record.
